spans.s:
The final इ and the उ of a wod with the exception of पीलु are lengthened before वह।

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

A preposition ending in इ or उ lengthens its final before काश।

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

In a मन्त्र the finals of the preceding member ending in इ or उ are lengthened before the particle सु।

Terms: संहिता Lengthening
